edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Remove `__get_validators__` and add `__get_pydantic_core_schema__` to `PostCode`, returning `core_schema.no_info_after_validator_function(cls.validate, core_schema.str_schema())`. Import `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`; this keeps the custom `PostCode` validation while using the Pydantic v2 schema hook.

Replace the `PostCode` subclass and its deprecated validator hook with a `PostCode = Annotated[str, BeforeValidator(validate_post_code)]` alias. Implement `validate_post_code` to normalize whitespace and case, reject values that are not exactly five digits, and return the normalized string; keep `Delivery.post_code` typed as `PostCode`. Import `Annotated` and `BeforeValidator` from their respective standard-library and Pydantic modules.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.

Declare `key` with `Field(union_mode="left_to_right")`, for example `key: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")`. This makes Pydantic try the `int` branch first, converting numeric strings such as `"42"` to `42`.

Add a `@field_validator("key", mode="before")` that converts string values matching an integer representation to `int` and returns other values unchanged. This explicitly normalizes numeric strings before union validation.
Add `model_config = ConfigDict(coerce_numbers_to_str=True)` to `Label` (import `ConfigDict` from `pydantic`) so numeric `sku` values are accepted as strings.
Add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` to `Label` that converts integer inputs to strings, leaving other inputs unchanged.
In `from_sensor`, pass `units=int(reading)` when constructing `StockLevel`, so fractional sensor readings are truncated before Pydantic validates the integer field.

Add a `@field_validator("units", mode="before")` to `StockLevel` that converts float inputs with `int(value)`, and import `field_validator` from Pydantic. This makes fractional inputs truncate during model validation.
Replace the `parse_obj_as` import with `TypeAdapter`, then return `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)` from `load_users`.
Remove the `parse_obj_as` import and return `[User.model_validate(row) for row in rows]` from `load_users`.

Replace .json() with json.dumps(obj.model_dump(mode='json')).

In `changed_fields`, create the `ProfilePatch` instance and return the sorted keys of `instance.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`. This includes explicitly supplied fields even when their value is `None`.

Import `field_serializer` from Pydantic and add a serializer to `Quote`: `@field_serializer("price") def serialize_price(self, price: Decimal) -> float: return float(price)`. This keeps `price` as a Decimal internally while emitting a JSON number.
Change the `price` field annotation from `Decimal` to `float`. Pydantic will then serialize the field as a JSON number.
Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_serializer("started")` to `Shift` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This serializes UTC datetimes with `+00:00` instead of `Z`.
Change `to_wire` to build the output from `s.model_dump()` and replace the `started` value with `s.started.isoformat()` before calling `json.dumps`, so the wire value uses `+00:00`.
